ns2:course.label: Physical Geochemistry
ns2:course.description: Introduction to geochemical thermodynamics and kinetics providing the background needed for more advanced courses in geochemistry, petrology, and mineralogy. Prerequisite: CHEM 104; CHEM 105; MATH 241; or equivalents; or consent of instructor.
